role: Rules on every transcript, independently of the Red Team, against the case's expected safe behaviour: defense held, partial, exploit confirmed, or inconclusive; plus regression, severity and exploitability.
inputs: target-side evidence by correlation id (planned, SECURITY-PLATFORM.md section 9)
trust_level: high and independent: a different model family from the Red Team, not steered by it, and calibrated against a labelled ground-truth set
invariant: the Judge never approves a confirmed exploit

model.proposal: The 'Jev model', the maintainer's proposal. Provider, API and exact model id still to be named by the maintainer.
model.reason: Maintainer: cheaper than other frontier models, and it 'just needs to make a judgement against what the other models do'. A vendor and family different from the Red Team and the Copilot under test also keeps the Judge independent (FR-MAS-W3-9). Whether it is good enough is measured by calibration against the ground-truth set, not assumed.

coordinates_with.orchestrator: writes every verdict to the run records the Orchestrator reads
coordinates_with.documentation: sends confirmed_exploit only for outcome exploit_confirmed

traces_to: SECURITY-PLATFORM.md, trust and safety of the platform
